author: Cuckwimp6
quote: To begin with, when they first meet—even though both are criminals—it’s definitely the woman who attacks the man and hurls insults at him, not the other way around. Then comes the "moral leverage" dynamic: even though she’s essentially a stray off the streets upon her release from prison, the man can’t just "kindly take her in." Instead, he’s forced to explicitly tell her that *he* needs her and *he* wants her there. Right before her release, there’s a series of menial tasks—like chopping things or unclogging toilets—where the stated reward is simply: "Lucia will be happy." And, of course, there’s the classic trope where her best friend joins in to berate the "simp" boyfriend: "Look at her friend’s boyfriend—he’s wealthy and successful!" "The drinks you bought are way too cheap; look at what the other guy buys!" "Don’t give me that 'serving the rich doesn't make you rich' nonsense—you need to show some ambition and provide a good life for me and our child!" "And if you don’t treat me right, my best friend won’t let you off the hook!"
